howItWorks: 1. On the Budget tab, pick the month, enter your budget period (reference only) and set your rollover from last month.
2. Fill in Expected amounts across Income, Expense Summary, Bill Tracker, Savings Tracker and Debt Payments Tracker.

3. Log every transaction once in the Transactions List — pick a Type, then a Category (the list depends on the Type), then an Amount. Every 'Actual' column above adds itself up from this one list — you never type an Actual by hand.
4. Tick off Bills and Debt payments as you pay them. Watch the Dashboard band and Cash Flow Summary update automatically.
5. On the Goal Tracker tab, log a handful of life goals and update Steps Done as you make progress.
key: Plain cell with no fill = calculated for you; leave it alone (the sheet is protected).
TOTAL / TOTAL LEFTOVER rows add themselves up.
The Transactions List is the only place you type an amount more than once — every table's Actual column is a live total pulled from it.
Green text on a Difference/Leftover = under budget or on track; terracotta = over budget.
A progress bar or ring fills in as Actuals, Paid ticks or Steps Done come in.
transactionTypes: Income (+) — money coming in: paycheck, business, side hustle, dividends, interest, commission.
Expenses (-) — everyday spending that isn't a recurring bill: food, transport, household, apparel and the like.

Bills (-) — recurring, fixed-due-date payments: internet, electricity, water, mobile, insurance. A credit-card statement itself is not a Bill — the purchases on it are already logged as Expenses, so logging the statement too would double-count them.
Debt (-) — loan and finance payments: student loans, mortgage, car payments.
Savings (-) — money set aside or invested: a travel fund, stocks, mutual funds, crypto.
sections.workedExample: Example — Transactions List: Date today, Type 'Expense', Category 'Food', Amount £42.50, Description 'Weekly shop'. Food's Actual on Expense Summary updates to £42.50 automatically — nothing else to fill in. Example — Goal Tracker: Life Area 'Finances', Goal 'Emergency fund', Steps Done 3, Steps Total 6 → Progress shows 50%.
sections.printing: File > Print. Each sheet has a print area and is scaled to fit one page wide. Choose Actual size / 100% scaling; A4 or US Letter both work.
